answer: Anchor every agent identity to a verifiable on-chain stake plus a unique hardware-backed credential, so creating a fake costs real capital. When one identity misbehaves, the penalty will ripple through its stake and linked reputation, making mass fakery unprofitable. Like a sparrow that must sing its own song to join the flock, each agent must prove ongoing useful work before earning trust or rewards, so sybils starve while honest agents compound credibility.
